test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 09 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

Body and soul
solution:
The correct answer is 4)** Wholly and entirely**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom "**body and soul**" refers to the entirety of a person, both their physical and spiritual being. It means to be completely devoted or dedicated to something.
 
• Therefore, "**wholly and entirely**" is the best alternative that expresses the same meaning. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 
• **Option 1) **"Life and death" refers to the extreme of mortality, and does not convey the meaning of being completely devoted or dedicated to something.
 
• **Option 2)** "To solve a difficulty" is unrelated to the meaning of the idiom.
 
• **Option 3) **"Happiness and sorrow" refers to the two opposite emotions and does not convey the meaning of being completely devoted or dedicated to something.
